# Zotero

> Zotero is a free, open-source personal research assistant for collecting, organizing, and citing sources across desktop, web, and mobile platforms.

Zotero helps researchers manage bibliographies, PDFs, and citations with seamless integration into Google Docs, Microsoft Word, and other writing tools. The platform supports collaborative research through cloud storage, browser extensions, and a vibrant community of developers and users.

## Key Topics

- Open-source reference manager
- Citation management
- Research organization
- Zotero Connector browser extension
- Cloud storage and sync
- PDF annotation
- Bibliography generation
- Collaborative research
- Mobile apps (iOS/Android)
- API and plugin development
- Google Docs integration
- Academic research tool
- Community contributions
- Cross-platform (Windows/macOS/Linux)
- Zotero 8 (latest version)

## Getting Started

- [Zotero | Your personal research assistant](https://www.zotero.org): Zotero homepage introducing the free research management tool
- [Zotero | Download](https://www.zotero.org/download): Download page for Zotero 8 across macOS, Windows, Linux
- [start [Zotero Documentation]](https://www.zotero.org/support): Documentation hub covering installation, setup, and core features
- [Zotero | Why Zotero?](https://www.zotero.org/why): Product overview highlighting open-source benefits and features

## Features & Services

- [Zotero | Storage](https://www.zotero.org/storage): Zotero Storage subscription plans and cloud sync features
- [dev:start [Zotero Documentation]](https://www.zotero.org/support/dev/start): Developer documentation for API, plugins, and contributions
